text:
maya: Quick sync re: nav IA for deep links. Two ideas: full-path expand vs compact breadcrumb with reveal controls. Need quick UX + A11y takes.
diego: Full-path expand is clearer for discoverability. But watch for layout jump on load.
rachel: Could prerender expanded DOM for deeplink loads to avoid jump. Also keep animations off for that path.
owen: Compact breadcrumb is nicer for huge trees; add a small parent badge that opens the group inline on click/Enter.
aria: A11y notes: always provide a visible H1 announcing path (visually hidden ok) and aria-live polite announcing "Location: X > Y". If auto-expand, move focus to the leaf or group header and set aria-current. If using reveal controls, ensure aria-controls and aria-expanded are present.
maya: Perf: virtualize the tree and only materialize the expanded path nodes. Also track deep_link_arrival event with depth and method (auto-expand vs breadcrumb).
diego: Copy for moved items: "This item was moved to [New Location]." CTA: "Open new location". Minimal.
maya: I'll update the spec with a hybrid rule: auto-expand up to depth=2, otherwise breadcrumb. PR spike incoming this week. Thanks all.
